subject: Proposal: targeted credit to expedite Olive Labs close (EoQ)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-time conversion credit for Olive Labs (EoQ ask)

Marissa / Sergio / Priya,

Quick ask as we push to close Olive Labs this quarter. Context: Olive is evaluating Redwood for inference across their ML infra team. We ran the PoC in Sept (good perf signals) and procurement is stalled pending pricing + a short budget window — they asked if we can apply a trial-topup / conversion credit to accelerate purchase this week.

Deal snapshot:
- ACV: $120k first year (expected)
- Contract length: 12 months
- Primary blockers: procurement needs a one-time credit applied to the first invoice to clear internal approval; they want the credit documented as an amendment.
- Timeline: procurement indicated a 10/07 cutoff for this budget cycle.

Request: approve up to $7,000 in one-time credits to be applied to the first invoice OR a 90-day trial extension + $5,000 credit. I recommend the latter (trial + $5k) to preserve margin while giving them runway to validate in production.

Why this is high-leverage: Olive is a strategic design platform (fast-growing, likely to expand usage) and they already integrated our SDK in two services. Losing this close will push renewal into next quarter and reduce conversion momentum.

If approved, I will:
- Send a short amendment doc for signatures (I attached a first-pass draft below)
- Coordinate procurement PO with their team
- Loop in Monica for onboarding support and credit activation steps

Attachments: credit-amendment-draft.docx (draft language; simple amendment that offsets first invoice by credit amount, not refundable)

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: credit-amendment-draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time conversion credit for Olive Labs (EoQ ask)

Raf — thanks for the clear snapshot. I support moving quickly but want to limit downside. Proposed approval: 1) Up to $5,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice; OR 2) 90-day trial extension + $3,500 credit if they sign an electronic amendment now.

Conditions:
- Credit applied only to first invoice and not refundable;
- Must include a minimum 12-month commitment in the amendment (no month-to-month);
- Deal must be logged in HubSpot and Monica must confirm onboarding slot (we can’t issue credits without CS sign-off).

Priya — can finance accept $5k cap here if we include the commitment language? If not, please advise counter.

Marissa
VP Sales
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time conversion credit for Olive Labs (EoQ ask)

Approving $5,000 one-time credit under the conditions Marissa listed. Please ensure the amendment includes:
- Explicit clause: credit applied to invoice #1 upon receipt of PO and executed amendment;
- No cash refunds; credit sits on account and is consumed by invoice line items only;
- Customer agreement to 12-month term and auto-renew unless notice given 60 days prior.

Also add a billing note in NetSuite referencing deal id RWI-2026-OL-39 to ensure proper accounting. Sergio, can you help stamp the billing code?

Priya
Head of Finance (Revenue Operations)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kristen Hall <kristen@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Offer: $5k conversion credit + onboarding support — Olive Labs

Hi Kristen — great speaking yesterday.

We want to make it easy for Olive Labs to start running Redwood in production this quarter. Per our internal approvals, we can offer a one-time $5,000 credit applied to your first invoice plus a 90-day onboarding package with Monica (priority setup). The credit will be documented as a short amendment to the Master Services Agreement and applied when we receive a PO and the executed amendment.

High-level terms:
- One-time credit: $5,000 applied to invoice #1
- Commitment: 12-month contract term (standard)
- Amendment: simple two-paragraph doc that confirms the credit and term (attached)
- Onboarding: Monica will run a kickoff and 4-week enablement plan to accelerate production use

Next steps if this works:
1) You share the PO (we can accept a purchase order to match the amendment)
2) Sign the attached amendment (I’ve attached the draft)
3) Monica and I will schedule kickoff within 3 business days of signed doc/PO

Attachment: Olive_PO_1023.pdf (if you have a PO ready)
Attachment: credit-amendment-draft.docx

If you’d like a small tweak to the amendment language, we can iterate — Marissa and Priya are looped for finance sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

— Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kristen Hall <kristen@olivelabs.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@olivelabs.com
Date: 2026-10-07T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer: $5k conversion credit + onboarding support — Olive Labs

Rafael — thanks, this looks good and solves the procurement hurdle. We will:
- Issue PO Olive-PO-1023 for signature this afternoon (attaching draft)
- Sign the amendment; can you confirm the amendment will be countersigned electronically?
- Request kickoff for next Tuesday if everything is executed by EOD tomorrow.

Can you also confirm the credit posts to the first invoice (month 1) and that there is a short billing memo we can include with the PO? Procurement needs line-item clarity.

Kristen Hall
Head of Platform, Olive Labs
Attachment: Olive_PO_1023.pdf (PO draft from procurement)
